fields.heading: The connection between them is broken.
fields.subhead: The workers are out there. The opportunities are out there. GoFindBuild was built by a 20 year construction veteran to connect them directly, with no recruiter in the middle.

fields.heading: Built by someone who has done the work
fields.aside: Brian spent twenty years in construction before writing a line of this. GoFindBuild is built in Indianapolis and works across central Indiana, for the firms and the trades that never found each other on a job board.

fields.heading: Find the people you need. Find the opportunity you deserve.
fields.subhead: Post a job, or build a free profile. Both take minutes.
